payload.content: When the question asks 'which X has the most/least/highest/lowest/maximum/minimum Y' or 'show the X with the largest/smallest Y', return the FULL ROW of X using `ORDER BY Y DESC LIMIT 1` (or ASC for least/min). Do NOT use MAX(Y) or MIN(Y) aggregates — those return only the value, not the row of the X that has that value, and break exec-match against the gold.

rationale: Targets spider q_asks_max_min=yes failures (41% fail rate). Pattern: model conflates 'value of extremum' (MAX/MIN aggregate) with 'row of extremum' (ORDER BY + LIMIT). Predicate: regex r'\b(most|least|highest|lowest|smallest|largest|maximum|minimum|biggest)\b.*\b(\w+)\b'.
